title: Backend: Data Models & DB Tables
description: Create StrategyBacktestRun, StrategyBacktestTrade, StrategyBacktestEquity ORM models in storage.py and Pydantic request/response models in src/strategy_backtest/models.py. These models capture the full PRD section 7 JSON structure and persist backtest results independently from the existing AI backtest tables.

criteria: StrategyBacktestRun table created with columns: id, code, start_date, end_date, initial_cash, commission_rate, slippage_rate, execution_mode, indicators_json, buy_rules_json, sell_rules_json, status, total_return, max_drawdown, win_rate, trade_count, avg_holding_days, created_at
StrategyBacktestTrade table created with columns: id, run_id (FK), trade_type (buy/sell), trade_date, price, shares, commission, profit, profit_rate
StrategyBacktestEquity table created with columns: id, run_id (FK), date, equity, cash, position_value, drawdown

Pydantic models in models.py covering: StrategyBacktestRequest (with indicators, buy_rules, sell_rules, code, dates, initial_cash, commission_rate, slippage_rate), StrategyBacktestRunResponse, StrategyBacktestTradeResponse, StrategyBacktestEquityResponse, StrategyBacktestSummary
Base.metadata.create_all creates all 3 new tables without errors
No modifications to existing backtest_results/backtest_summaries tables
